text:
Assistant A gives a more detailed and structured answer: geotechnical investigation (including liquefaction), seismic design codes, structural system options, ductile materials, redundancy, and inspections. It has some imperfections. "Isolated footings with seismic isolators" is loosely worded, and expansion joints are presented as a seismic measure when they mainly handle thermal movement, though seat width and restrainers matter in earthquakes. It also doesn't mention the 1.8 km length or the river crossing specifically, such as scour or the choice of bridge type. Even so, it is substantively useful.

Assistant B is generic and brief. It mentions a seismic hazard assessment, ductile materials, shock absorbers, flexible joints, a stable foundation, and monitoring. It offers little depth or specificity.

Assistant A is more helpful, more detailed, and more accurate overall.

[[A]]
